parameters.query:
SELECT id,
       '[id=' || id || '] Компетенция: ' || competency || 
       ' | Навык: '  ||   skill_name ||
       ' | Тип: '    ||   coalesce(skill_type, '') ||
       ' | Описание: ' || coalesce(skill_description, '') AS row_text
FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_skills g
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "ASiruk".interview_questions q
    WHERE q.source_table = 'guidebook_skills' AND q.source_id = g.id
)
ORDER BY id;

SELECT id,
       '[id=' || id || '] Принцип: ' || principle ||
       ' | Область: ' || coalesce(soft_skill_area, '') ||
       ' | Маркеры: ' || coalesce(behavior_options, '') AS row_text
FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_principles g
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "ASiruk".interview_questions q
    WHERE q.source_table = 'guidebook_principles' AND q.source_id = g.id)
ORDER BY id;

SELECT id,
       '[id=' || id || '] Задача: ' || task ||
       ' | Зона: '   ||   coalesce(responsibility_area, '') ||
       ' | Уровень: ' ||  coalesce(career_level, '') ||
       ' | Описание: ' || coalesce(aspect_description, '') AS row_text
FROM "ASiruk".guidebook_tasks g
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "ASiruk".interview_questions q
    WHERE q.source_table = 'guidebook_tasks' AND q.source_id = g.id)
ORDER BY id;
